title: Excavations in Palestine, 1934-5: Jerusalem, Kidron Valley
author: (round-up; survey directed by E. L. Sukenik)
location_note: Kidron Valley necropolis: east slope of Wadi Sal'a opposite Kh. Beit Sahur, and near the Bedouin cemetery north of Kh. Beit Sahur el-'Atiqa; no map reference; placed by name.
notes: Hebrew University survey of the Kidron necropolis. Tomb 1: forecourt, antechamber, sealed door, chamber with nine kokhim (more planned), five ossuaries (one 'Judah son of Jonathan, son of Ithra'), painted Aramaic inscription over a kokh. Tomb 2: one rock-cut room partly lined with ashlar, inscribed ossuary fragments ('Apphias daughter of Athenagoras', 'Hania son of Alexa', 'Ostophagos').
